title: 购物车
intro: 来自 {{stalls}} 的 {{products}}。为每个摊位选择取货时间，然后下单。

empty.title: Your cart is empty
empty.text: Add products from a stall's page and they show up here, split by stall.

split.title_one: Your cart will be split into {{count}} order at {{count}} stall.
split.title_other: Your cart will be split into {{count}} orders at {{count}} stalls.
split.text: 每个摊位有自己的取货时间和截单时间，并分别接受订单。取货时向各摊位付款。

noSlots.title: No pickup times yet
noSlots.text: This stall has not opened any pickup slots for this market. Try again later or remove this stall's items.

problem.out_of_stock: One or more items have less stock than you asked for.
problem.sold_out: One or more items are sold out.
problem.unavailable: One or more items are no longer for sale.
problem.stall_suspended: This stall is not taking orders right now.

note.label: 给摊位的备注
note.placeholder: 例如：请把每把分小一点

ready_one: Your stall has a pickup time. It confirms your order.
ready_other: All stalls have a pickup time. Each stall confirms its own order.
notReady: 请选择在 {{stall}} 的取货时间后再下单。
stockNote: 下单后，库存会立即从摊位的数量中扣除。不支持在线支付。

stuck.title: 购物车中的商品
stuck.text: 如果某个商品已不再出售，请在这里删除它，购物车就会重新加载。
